question: In which year was Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi born?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1869.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi** **was born in 1869.**
 
• **This means that he lived during a time when India was under British colonial rule.**
 
• Gandhi played a crucial role in the Indian independence movement through non-violent civil disobedience** **and peaceful protests.
 
• During its fight for independence, he led the nation in the non-cooperation movement in 1922, the Salt March in 1930, and the Quit India movement in 1942.
 
• His legacy continues to inspire people around the world to fight for justice, equality, and freedom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi was an Indian independence activist who is widely known as** Mahatma Gandhi.**
 
• **He was a prominent figure in India's struggle for independence from British rule.**
 
• Gandhi was born in **Porbandar**, a coastal town in present-day Gujarat, India.
 
• His birthday, **October 2ⁿd,** is celebrated as a national holiday in India as** Gandhi Jayanti.**
